notes: Generated mission list files at 0x1d0000: optional leading tabs/spaces, a row count (0..12, sometimes one less than the rows present, zero or negative) with CRLF or LF, then rows title$briefing$config with no level (CRLF or LF) or $level (CRLF, or LF when the level is shorter than the count line so the stale count digits are reparsed). File names advanced.txt and others, network flag 0/1/0x80 and random minimum levels. 0x9c980 writes "A:"; the size and load hooks log a hash and the length of the path (load also EDX) and the size hook returns per-case sizes (sometimes 0, so the error hook runs; the add-on probes return 0, 1 or random); the error hook logs its format; arena alloc returns the file, realloc logs EAX/EDX and returns 0x1d4000 (prefilled with 0xcc), arena free logs EAX. strcat, parse_int and strcmp run as originals.
